from datetime import datetime, timedelta

async def main(args: Args) -> Output:
    params_list = args.params   # input 是数组

    records = []

    for params in params_list['input']:
        # -------------------------
        # 时间处理（bstudio_create_time）
        # -------------------------
        clean_str = params['bstudio_create_time'].replace(" UTC", "")
        utc_datetime = datetime.strptime(clean_str, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %z")
        utc8_datetime = utc_datetime + timedelta(hours=8)
        formatted_time = utc8_datetime.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

        # -------------------------
        # 单条记录组装
        # -------------------------
        record = {
            "危险源名称": params.get('wxname', ""),
            "隐患基本情况": params.get('yhinfo', ""),
            "隐患图片链接": params.get('photo', ""),
            "隐患等级": params.get('yhdengji', ""),
            "发现时间": formatted_time,  # 或 params.get('faxiantime', "") 取决于你要用哪个
            "治理措施和方法": params.get('zhilicuoshi', ""),
            "责任部门和责任人": params.get('zerenbumen', ""),
            "治理时限": params.get('zhilitime', ""),
            "安全防范和应急措施": params.get('yingjicuoshi', ""),
            "治理结果": params.get('zhiliresult', ""),
            "验收意见及时间": params.get('yanshoutime', ""),
            "验收人": params.get('yanshoupeople', "")
        }
        records.append(record)

    # -------------------------
    # 构建输出对象
    # -------------------------
    ret: Output = {
        "body": {
            "inputs": {
                "url": "https://epctalkk.feishu.cn/base/KCTJbWESRacCOLsKkCDc7GvInlf",
                "records": json.dumps(records, ensure_ascii=False)
            },
            "response_mode": "blocking",
            "user": "rokid"
        }
    }
    return ret
